title: External catalog consistency through hosted task initialization
description: An isolated gateway and node have different cookbook bytes and a pack with no node_support declaration or farm-script hooks. A real run.create, node task.runtime and installed CLI must prepare and dispatch using the shipped gateway catalog, preserving the node checkout. No model or production run is used; owned fixture resources are cancelled, archived and cleaned.

dispatch.intent: Use authenticated run.create and actual node/CLI initialization to prove a mutable node catalog cannot replace the gateway's selected bytes.
